issue.title: RN iOS: the AI journal never finds its own attempt folders, so no picture is sent
issue.body:
Part of #2978. Found on the iPad while verifying #3068, with a diagnostic build at ccd185b08425d71fe736792dab7c442ece8f4c0e.

## What happens

With credentials readable again, a free creation on the iPad still fails before anything is sent. The result card shows "Still not working".

## Cause

`SplotchAIJournal.swift`'s `readPreparedUpload` rejects with `AI storage was not confirmed. Nothing new was sent.` A diagnostic build that carried the failing line into the rejection logged this:

```
[diag readPreparedUpload AI_DURABILITY_UNAVAILABLE 719 journal line 719]
```

Line 719 is `try checked(attempts(root).contains(dir))`. Here `dir` is built as `root.appendingPathComponent("attempt-<id>")`, but `attempts(root)` returns `FileManager.contentsOfDirectory(at:)` URLs, which differ on the device:

```
listing     file:///private/var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/<app>/Library/Application%20Support/splotch-ai-journal-v1/attempt-<id>/
constructed file:///var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/<app>/Library/Application%20Support/splotch-ai-journal-v1/attempt-<id>
```

The URLs differ in the `/private` prefix and the trailing slash, so URL equality never matches.

The same check guards `write`/`retain`, `commitRecoveryIntent`/`recordRecoveryStatus` and `sourceHeld`. The stored result URI check in `latest()` compares a listing-derived URL with one the journal wrote from the constructed form. Android's `File.equals` compares the constructed paths it lists, so only iOS fails.

## Done when

* `attempts()` returns each attempt as `root.appendingPathComponent(name)`, so every comparison sees the form the journal writes.
* A source guard keeps it that way.
* A free creation on the iPad shows its picture.
issue.display_title: RN iOS: the AI journal never finds its own attempt folders, so no picture is sent

comments.body: Fixed by #3070, merged as 29eb9e641c51fccc9f382d7c095e3cb37e783e16. Verified on the iPad (Release): AI Art showed "10 free AI creations left" instead of an unavailable allowance, a credential saved and read back, and a free Watercolor creation came back and displayed with Download and Report.
